name: JM Press EZ Bar (Strict Form)
description: The JM press performed with strict technique using an EZ curl bar. The angled EZ bar reduces wrist discomfort at the unusual elbow-flare position this exercise requires. Strict form emphasizes pure tricep strength without momentum or body English.

execution.starting_position: Set up for JM Press EZ Bar (Strict Form) in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for JM Press EZ Bar (Strict Form).
steps: Step 1: Lie on bench with EZ bar at arm's length. Set grip slightly wider than close.
Step 2: Lower bar toward throat with elbows pointing at approximately 45 degrees.
Step 3: Lower under full control until forearms break horizontal.
Step 4: Drive bar back to lockout through tricep extension.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Lowering to chest instead of throat
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Throat is the target, not the chest
EZ bar reduces wrist angle stress
